note: Gathering on foot (docs/future/13-keepers-camp.md 4.2, 4.4, 4.5; src/world/gather/). reachM: arm's reach (m) for a Gather; waterReachM: into water from the bank (lily leaves, pondweed). nearLookM: ground that is everywhere (sand, pebbles, flat stones, a strandline stretch) opens its card when tapped within this many meters of the walker; a tap further off just walks (Matt, 2026-10-22). kneelS: the kneel for one handful; approachTimeoutS: how long the walk to a spot may take before it gives up. eventCap: the most picked spots the save remembers (oldest go first). spotM: the side of a ground spot's bin (m), over the 0.5 m water cells. marksMax: picked-over marks drawn near the view. plants: regrowth model B. A pick sets size = max(floor x best, size x (1 - share)); a plant is pickable when it has been mature (best at least matureSize), its size is at least readyShare x best, and the part is in its season window. While size < readyShare x best, a picked plant's hourly growth is multiplied by recoverRate x (1 + rainBoost x rain + mistBoost x mist), rain and mist this hour's (weather now). defaults: share and readyShare by part type. parts: one entry per gatherable plant part, keyed '<species>.<part>', naming its type (for the defaults) and its window as season positions [from, to) (0 spring .. 4, wrapping, as flora recipes' flowering and dormant windows), read on the plant's own calendar (phenology); its own share or readyShare overrides the type's. Reed down: late autumn into winter. weather: windyMin is the day record's windStrength for a windy day (today or yesterday); onshoreDot: a tide's day is onshore when dot(windToward, outward) is at most this, windToward = (cos windDir, -sin windDir), outward from the island's centre to the stretch; springMin: how far toward spring a line's tide must be for cast kelp; fireNightH: hours a fire must burn between dusk and dawn. bins: steepDeg is the slope (degrees) at which sand on the shore counts as shingle; ankleM is the deepest a stream bed's water may be for pebbles; tapM, how near its cell (m) a tap must land to find a bin's spot. strand: toleranceM, how far (m) a cell's ground may sit from a line's level (plus the shore recipe's runupM) and still be on it. kinds: one per ground kind (Phase 1: sticks, drift twigs, pebbles, flat stones). source is where it lies (foot of a host plant, a ground bin, a strandline stretch); handfuls and empty are by season (spring, summer, autumn, winter): empty is the share of spots holding nothing that period, otherwise a spot holds handfuls plus the modifiers. sticks: hosts and hostMin (the least stage of the host); windy adds that many on a windy day (today or yesterday), when empty is emptyWindy instead. drift-twigs: lines is how many of the newest lines carry them; onshore adds that many when the tide's day was onshore, when empty is emptyOnshore. pebbles and flat stones: where names the ground they lie on (shoreShingle: sand or shingle in or above the tide band; streamBed: running or slow fresh water no deeper than ankleM; bandRock: rock in the tide band; steepShingle: shore sand at least steepDeg steep). words: the card's lines.

words.strandPicked: Picked over. The next tide will bring more.
words.young: Still small. Let it grow first.
words.asleep: Asleep for winter. Nothing to pick.
words.holding: It is holding on to the rock. Leave it be.
words.above: You can gather this on foot.
words.sleepers: Frogs sleep in the mud here.
words.tooBig: Too big to lift. It is rooted deep.
words.acorns: Too bitter. These are for the jay.
